summary: Developed blockchain applications using Hyperledger Fabric, R3 Corda, and Ethereum. Built enterprise blockchain systems for supply chain, resource sharing, and asset digitization. Created chatbot systems for enterprise clients including IHCL and Shoppers Stop with payment integration and WhatsApp deployment.

Built IDO launchpad, NFT marketplace, and multi-chain naming service using Ethereum and StarkNet. Developed Cairo and Solidity smart contracts, generative NFT algorithms, and custodial wallet systems using Node.js and HashiCorp Vault. Conducted Layer 2 research and contributed to StarkNet and StarkEx integrations.

Developed backend services in Rust for high-fidelity trading aggregation system. Integrated exchange APIs including Binance, KuCoin, Huobi, and Kraken. Built authentication and automated API testing frameworks using Node.js, Jest, and Supertest.
